newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer names Kone's Paalanne CFO.
newsitem.headline: Amer names Kone's Paalanne CFO.

text.p: Finnish sport goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it had appointed Pekka Paalanne, 46, chief financial officer effective March 1.
"Pekka Paalanne ... has been appointed as Senior Vice President & Chief Financial Officer of Amer," it said.
Paalanne will be responsible for the group's finance, treasury and administration functions, it said.
He will join Amer from Finnish lift maker Kone Oy, where he is currently senior vice president, corporate control, Amer said.
Paalanne will start at Amer following the resignation of current CFO Kari Miettinen, who will leave the company at the end of March.
Amer also appointed Eero Alperi, 39, director of corporate planning and business development effective February 14.

Alperi will be responsible for corporate planning, strategic supervision and management resources. He will join Amer from Merita Bank, part of Merita Oy, where for the last two years he has been a vice president with responsibility for risk management and corporate finance in the Helsinki region.
